ashok: nightly eval alert — anchor cohort recall@5 dropped from 0.87 -> 0.63 after last quant rollout :eyes:
nightly-ci: job nightly-rag-evals/2045678899 finished. failures: 12/150 prompt sets flagged. see /ci/artifacts/2045678899/summary.json
maria: which model and quant profile was rolled?
ashok: redwood/enc-4b v1.2 with q4-int8 rollout at 03:10 UTC — percentage rollout 25% for embed service. reranker untouched (reranker-v2).
rebecca: quick sanity: is this a reranker scoring shift or retrieval recall drop? numbers look like topk mismatch rather than rerank reorder.
luis: looked at sample diffs — many failures are anchorset where top doc id flips to an unrelated doc, embeddings angle seems different. attaching tiny t-SNE snapshot (in artifact).
maria: can you paste the eval command you ran?
luis: ```python eval/run_rag_eval.py --index cohort_anchorset --model redwood/enc-4b@v1.2 --quant q4-int8 --topk 5 --out diffs.json```
rebecca: thanks. can we repro locally with the non-quant model to confirm baseline?
ashok: yes repro on cpu fallback gives baseline recall 0.88. with quantized weights locally we reproduce drop to ~0.64. so quantization mapping likely the culprit.
maria: any evidence of scale/clipping change in embedding norm distribution?
luis: embedding L2 mean shifted 1.9 -> 1.2 after q4. also cosine similarity between original and quantized embeddings median 0.84 -> 0.61 for anchor queries.
rebecca: that magnitude will change nearest-neighbor ordering. suspect Q4 per-group outlier handling — might be zero-point/rescale mismatch for grouped quantization.
maria: can we roll back rollout flag for the embed service to 0% and re-run nightly?
ashok: I'll patch the rollout in the control plane now. pinging @infra to confirm immediate traffic shift.
ashok: infra confirmed cutback applied — embed service rolled to v1.1 (no quant).
nightly-ci: triggered rerun nightly-rag-evals/2045678902 (manual)
luis: re-run results preliminary: recall@5 back to 0.86 on anchor cohort. failing prompts reduced to 2/150 and they look like outlier edge cases.
rebecca: good. next steps: create a targeted quant unit test across anchorset to catch embedding norm shifts, add cosine-preservation metric to model onboarding checks, and open a bug for quant pack (assign to eng-ml-quant).
maria: file please, and include minimal repro and the diffs.json snippet.
ashok: filing ticket now: QNT-3422 — "q4-int8 grouped quantization causes embed norm shift for enc-4b". adding attachments.
luis: leaving a quick note: we should avoid global rollout until we have cosine-preservation >= 0.9 on core cohorts.
rebecca: agree. marking this thread resolved once tickets and tests are in. :white_check_mark:
